goal: Parse command-line options placed after non-option arguments using GNU-style conventions
Stop silently swallowing unrecognized options or flags into positional parameters across CLI tools
Support the standard '--' separator to end option parsing
reviewability: Ready to review; all review comments were resolved with tests and the head commit has an ACK
agreement: Detailed review and verification of multiple edge cases led to an ACK on the current head (w0xlt)
Raised discrepancy in bitcoin-tx behavior that was subsequently resolved (vicjuma)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it stops bitcoin-cli from silently ignoring flags like -rpcwallet placed after commands
Prevents users from accidentally running RPC operations against the wrong wallet

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because it lets bitcoin-tx consume pre-parsed commands correctly
Prevents flags placed after transaction inputs from triggering command-line errors

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it adds GNU-style option parsing across all tools via shared argument handling
Catches invalid options early and allows '--' to terminate option processing cleanly
